mentions.name: Orshot
mentions.description: A Canva-like design tool for automated image, PDF, and video generation via API, with integrations for n8n, Zapier, Make, Airtable, and Pipedream. Users design a template, autofill its layers with data from anywhere, and generate visual marketing content at scale.
mentions.audience: Agencies and teams that use it to automate visual content like PDF invoices/reports and Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest posts
mentions.source_excerpt:
i’m working on Canva like app for automated image/pdf/video via API, also connects with n8n, zapier, make, airtable, pipedream etc.

it’s https://orshot.com
